title: Shared and private memory
caption: The postmaster makes one shared block, then forks backends that each keep their own private memory.

badges.meaning: Postmaster creates the shared block at startup
Postmaster forks a backend for each client
The backend maps the shared block
The backend allocates private memory contexts
Page cache reads and writes data files
The OS OOM killer may kill a backend

title: Memory from startup to kill
caption: Startup sizes and carves the shared block once, then every connection forks a backend that builds contexts and runs queries.

badges.meaning: Child may be killed on OOM

title: The memory context tree
caption: Contexts nest in a tree and the badge shows how long each lives, so resetting a context frees everything below it.

badges.meaning: Lives as long as the whole backend
